name: tab03
definition: 业务主记录 Counterexample: 与 tab04、tab05 等明细/扩展表易混：本对象是表族代表的主记录，其余表为围绕它的明细或扩展信息，而非同一实体的另一副本 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab03; provenance: direct source tab03

name: tab04
definition: 业务明细记录 Counterexample: 与 tab03 主记录易混：本对象为依附主记录的明细/扩展信息条目，不是独立业务实体 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab04; provenance: direct source tab04

name: tab05
definition: 业务扩展信息记录 Counterexample: 与 tab03 主记录易混：本对象承载主记录的扩展属性集合，不是主记录本身 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab05; provenance: direct source tab05

name: tab06
definition: 业务附属记录 Counterexample: 与 tab05 扩展记录易混：本对象列集独立，属另一类附属信息，不能与扩展属性表合并 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab06; provenance: direct source tab06

name: tab07
definition: 业务关联记录 Counterexample: 与 tab04 明细易混：本对象列集与明细表不同，属另一类关联信息条目 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab07; provenance: direct source tab07

name: tab08
definition: 业务从属记录 Counterexample: 与 tab04 易混：两者共享 fld005、fld008，但列集不同，属不同从属信息条目 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab08; provenance: direct source tab08

name: tab01
definition: tab01 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab01; provenance: direct source tab01

name: User
definition: A registered account on the site, identified by user id and display name.

name: Post
definition: A content item (question/post) authored by a user.

name: PostTitle
definition: The title text of a post.

name: PostBody
definition: The body text of a post.

name: PostViewCount
definition: Number of times a post has been viewed.

name: PostScore
definition: The score/rating assigned to a post.

name: PostCommentCount
definition: Number of comments attached to a post.

name: PostAnswerCount
definition: Number of answers attached to a post.

name: PostOwner
definition: The user who owns/authored a post.

name: Comment
definition: A comment left on a post, with text and score.

name: UserAge
definition: The age of a user.

name: UserCreationDate
definition: The date a user account was created.

name: LastAccessDate
definition: The date a user last accessed the website.

name: Link
definition: A hyperlink created in a post.

name: AvgUserAge
definition: Average age of users. Formula: UserAge / User. Inputs: UserAge = tab07.fld048; User = tab07.fld039

name: AvgViewCount
definition: Average number of views per post. Formula: PostViewCount / Post. Inputs: PostViewCount = tab05.fld018; Post = tab05.fld001

name: MonthlyLinksCreated
definition: Links created in a year divided by 12 months. Formula: Link / 12. Inputs: Link = tab04.fld001

name: PostsPerUser
definition: Count of posts owned by a user. Formula: Post / User. Inputs: Post = tab05.fld001; User = tab07.fld039

name: CommentsPerPost
definition: Average number of comments per post. Formula: Comment / Post. Inputs: Comment = tab06.fld035; Post = tab05.fld001

name: ScorePerView
definition: Post score normalized by views. Formula: PostScore / PostViewCount. Inputs: PostScore = tab05.fld026; PostViewCount = tab05.fld018
